candidate.compile_only_check: passed before preregistration; no XPU tensor was allocated

mechanism.scope: Only 3D W8A16 activation input selects the experimental path; ordinary 2D calls are unchanged.
mechanism.row_invariance_argument: Every real row is evaluated inside the same static four-row primitive. Total M changes only B and final padding, not the per-tile M descriptor.

required_for_expansion: Both representative shapes execute without exception.
One row-0 bit pattern across every tested B, including total rows 168-256.
Every batched output is bitwise equal to the same rows evaluated as independent static M=4 calls.
An arbitrary 128-row permutation at B=32 is bitwise invariant after reindexing.
Repeated B=16 calls are bitwise exact.
B=1 latency is no more than 2x an ordinary static M=4 call.
B=32 and B=64 latency are each no more than 1.5x the natural flattened-M call.
No Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, or device loss.
gates.on_pass: Add padding/content checks for all prompt row counts, then expand to all six production W8A16 shapes before any server integration.
gates.on_failure: Preserve the result and do not launch a server. Distinguish unsupported scale broadcasting, B-dependent arithmetic, and latency failure.
